verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own CLI accepts a natural-language instruction (`-q "Extract all product prices"`), and its LLM-driven extraction handles it, so users can hand narrow extraction tasks to a built-in LLM. That is a single-purpose, query-driven feature, not a general built-in assistant. MCP integration and the skill package serve external AI tools, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented built-in conversational assistant/agent, multi-step task delegation, in-depth docs on the -q assistant behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
